there is no single "right" way of doing research synthesis for healthcare policy makers and managers.
research synthesis for the benefit of healthcare managers and policy makers is a challenging and complex task that requires considerable skill and experience.
there is no single "best" approach to synthesis for managers and policymakers, and that the choice of approach will be determined by the question, context and purpose of the synthesis.

the methods of research synthesis are not fixed, but are evolving to meet the needs and expectations of the healthcare managers and policy makers who use the results.

research synthesis can and should be done in a way that is useful to managers and policy makers.
